I've been off and on keto all this year, mostly off. Before that, I was on for many years at a time.

I decided to go back this week and to ease myself back in, I decided to sweeten up my morning eggs. Eating is sometimes tough in the morning, but it's a lot easier when what you're having is sweet.

  • 2 or 3 eggs
  • package of your favourite keto-friendly sweetener
  • 2 tbsp heavy cream or cream cheese or sour cream or plain yogurt

Mix all ingredients well (you may need some sort of powered mixer if you're using cream cheese) and scramble in a hot pan. Add salt to taste after it's cooked and enjoy.

I've never actually tried it with sour cream or yogurt, but how bad could it be, really. Try it for yourself.

My plan is to slowly wean myself off the sweetener... maybe over the period of a week.
